news.title: “Every Team at the World Cup Is a Champion” — Busari Warns Flamingos Against Underestimating Opponents in Morocco
news.lede: Flamingos head coach Akeem Busari has warned his players against underestimating any opponent at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco, insisting that Nigeria must approach every match with the same determination and respect. Busari stressed that every country competing at the tournament has earned its place through a demanding qualification process, making it dangerous to judge opponents by their reputation or previous achievements. “For any country that comes into a World Cup, it shows they are prepared for them to get their qualification,” Busari said. “So all of us are champions now.

news.title: 'Falklands issue was a special ingredient': Lautaro lifts lid on Argentina’s World Cup grudge match against England
news.lede: Lautaro Martinez has revealed how Argentina’s long-running dispute with England over the Falkland Islands added an emotional edge to their 2026 World Cup semifinal, describing the clash as far more than a football match and dedicating his decisive goal to veterans of the 1982 war. The Inter Milan striker scored a 92nd-minute winner as Argentina came from behind to beat England 2-1 in Atlanta on July 15, booking their place in a second consecutive World Cup final. The goal has since taken on a significance beyond the result, particularly among Argentines who continue to regard the conflict over the islands as a defining chapter in their national history. In an interview with AFA Estudio, Martinez became emotional when shown footage of a Malvinas War veteran breaking down in tears while celebrating his goal.

news.title: FIFA Unveils Brand for 2027 U-20 World Cup in Uzbekistan, Azerbaijan
news.lede: Tashkent, Uzbekistan (UzDaily.uz) — FIFA has unveiled the official brand for the 2027 FIFA U-20 World Cup, which will be held in Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan. The tournament’s slogan, “U Shape The Game”, is intended to inspire young footballers to showcase their talent and leave their mark on the history of the sport. The brand concept highlights the youth World Cup as a platform where promising players can demonstrate their abilities, gain international experience and make a name for themselves on the global stage. The official emblem draws on the cultural heritage of Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan.

news.title: FIFA to Amend Disciplinary Rules After Folarin Balogun World Cup Ban Controversy
news.lede: FIFA has announced plans to amend its disciplinary regulations following controversy over the suspension of United States forward Folarin Balogun’s automatic one-match ban, which allowed him to feature against Belgium in their FIFA World Cup last-16 clash. The decision follows concerns raised by the Royal Belgian Football Association (RBFA) over the circumstances surrounding FIFA’s decision to suspend the sanction and the potential implications for the independence and transparency of its disciplinary process. According to the Belgian federation, FIFA will revise Article 27 of its Disciplinary Code, which permits the suspension of disciplinary sanctions under exceptional circumstances. The proposed amendment is expected to be submitted for approval at the next FIFA Council meeting scheduled for December 16 in Doha, Qatar.

news.title: FIFA unveils official brand of the 2027 World Cup, which will be held in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan
news.lede: Today FIFA unveiled the official brand of the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2027™. The brand invites a new generation of football stars to write history at the tournament, which will be held in Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan. The official slogan — "This game is for you" — is addressed both to young footballers and to the fans supporting them. This was reported to 1news.az by the Association of Football Federations of Azerbaijan (AFFA).
